items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: faction of Charles Delaunay was in evidence there by the appearance of Charlie Parker

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

faction of Charles Delaunay was in evidence there by the appearance of Charlie Parker and the modernists, and the emergence of Hugues Panassie, who is with the traditional guys like Sidney Bechet and they pit them all together, you know. I think it's mostly a money-making proposition to draw the people in. But it was Sidney Bechet that held that whole crowd in there and I'm going back downstairs when Charlie said, "I hate to follow that old man, that old man's got the people by the -- what am I going to do?" I…

So at one point I heard the band from Germany come in to follow Bechet and they booed them off. They made so much noise that they couldn't play. Bechet was off the bandstand and this band from Germany came on stage and started to play and these people, the whole multitude of them, the people that were there, jam-packed in the Salle Pleyel, made so much noise, they don't want it, they want Bechet. They made so much noise that the band stopped playing and poor guys, they got off the bandstand. And when Bechet came…
